main_text.p: ryphorus, Cic. Defensor corporis, Vlp. Stipator Prætoris, Cic. Lanearius, Speculator, Suet. Spiculator, Turneb. Regiæ domus armati excubitores. Apparitur regis, Liv. Circumpedes. A pedibus. A latere alicujus. A corporis custodia.
Satellitium] Cohors ad custodiam corporis institu​ta, Suet. Cohors prætoria, Cic. Tac. Castra prætoria, Bud. Custodes vitæ, Lamp.
Satiare] Exsatiare, Sil. Saturare famem epulis, Claud. Exsaturare. Afferre satietatem, Cic. Explere aliquem, Ter. Satullare, Var. Obsaturare aliquem.

Satiari] Satiari legendo. Saturari nummis. Saturare se, Cicero. Satias me tenet hujus, Teren. Satias eum cepit amoris, Liv. Cum sat habet satias, manum de mensa tollere, Var. Satietatem ferre ex copia, Quintilian. Libidines nec expleri nec satiari ullo modo possunt, Cicero.
Satietas[ Satias: ad satiatem; cum satiate, Acc. Lucr. Saturitas, Plaut. Expletio, Cic. Saties, Plin.
Satietas fastidium parit] Satietas fastidii mater.
Satis] Sat: satis superque, Cic. Affatim, Ter. Abunde, Col. Quantumvis prolationum. Largiter, Plaut. Pax, nihil amplius, Ter. Tantum, Priscian. Sat abunde. Usque affatim.
Satisfacere] Satisfacere alicui rei, Cic. de aliqua re, Quint. Litare sævitiæ, Apul. id est, Exsaturare crudelitatem, Beroal. Respondere, Cic. vid Promissum solvere.
Sativus] Delita femina, Var. stipes desertus (insitus) in agro, Tibul.
Satur] Saturatus. Expletus. Cibo gravis, onustus, Cic. Fessus satietate videndi, Lucr. Satullus, Var.
Saturnus] Mundi splen. Sidus grave Saturni, Propert.
Saucius] Ex vulnere æger, vid. Vulneratus.

page.notes: Scan is a single printed page; the faint show-through from the reverse side is omitted. Some words in the text are doubtful due to the print: "Lanearius" may be "Lanearius"; "Satias" forms are as printed.
